members.claim: Any circle step without a fill color now renders as a horizontal line, not just the outline circles this change is aimed at. Existing callers rely on the old outline circle to mean a point. `registerNewGeometryLayer.ts:34` (style `{ color: mainColor }`) and `DEFAULT_USER_LAYER_LEGEND` in `features/create_layer/constants.ts:39` (stepName 'Point', `color`/`width` only, no fill) both match this case. So point layers, including the default user-created 'Point' layer, will now show a line icon, which reads as a line or road layer. Either make the line rendering opt-in (for example a separate 'line' shape) or update these callers to give a fill or another shape.

findings.reason: SimpleLegend.tsx:17 falls back to '#000000', but lines 51-54 only set the label colour when text-color exists, so otherwise the label inherits its colour. On a non-black theme the icon and label differ. This is a cosmetic mismatch, so it stays low.
findings.claim: With no text-color set, the letter icon falls back to #000000 while the label inherits the theme colour, so the two can mismatch.
findings.evidence: When there is no `text-color`, the letter icon is forced to `#000000`. In that case the label has no inline color and inherits the theme text color, so the icon and label won't match on non-black themes or dark mode. That undermines the stated aim of matching the label. Fall back to `currentColor`, or leave the color unset so it inherits.
